lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour, materials and artefacts. Candidate: S/rC (q15-q17) and S/sC (studio). Before: S/rB and S/sB, which are w49 geometry (09a_econ.js from db946d6) on the same lighting. I read the db946d6..58aca6d diff of 09a_econ.js; only the headrest changed (cushion, wing rolls, CPL drape, fold, hem/stitch/mark, per-block hd, and the far-LOD head boxes). Scripts and crops are in S/raterB50. tri_q15/q16/q17 are render / photo / before stacks. cover17.png and cover17z.png are q17 near-right headrest crops. cov.py segments the q17 near cover (low-saturation blob) and writes masks.png. Inline q15 segmentation of the four front covers plus column profiles, and q17 column class profiles at the cover centre (x 672 render / 712 photo / 687 before). st1.png and st2.png pair every changed studio shot, after against before. A pixel diff of all 13 studio shots shows changes only in e1, e2 (top strip), e3, e4, e4b, e4c, e5 (top) and e9. e6, e7, e8, e10 and e11 are pixel-identical.
calibrationNote: One medium is closed and one has a new problem. q15 head-on (w49b-1) is fixed: the centre-block covers segment at y 244-301, 78 x 58, h/w 0.74. y_47300 is 239-292, h/w 0.75; w49 was 251-315, h/w 0.83-0.85. The top is 5 px low and the foot 9 px low, but the cover is now ~7 px (10 %) too wide, because the cushion came 3 cm forward and the centre block 2 cm up. q17 (w49b-2) did not improve and regressed in a new way. The near-side wing roll is now as proud as the cover (wing front z ~-0.155 vs CPL -0.152..-0.158). From the aisle-side camera it sits in front of the lower-right half of the flap, so the flap reads as a small lid above a big fleck ball. y_47303 shows the flap clearly in front of a slimmer roll; this is the w45 'wings hid the q17 cover' problem come back. The q17 cover blob went from 4869 to 3657 px (photo 4224) and from 98 to 78 px tall (photo 100). Its bottom is unchanged at ~229-240 (photo 280-283), and its top came down 14 px (148 -> 162; photo 183). The per-block height reads plausibly: q16 left-block covers now show back fabric above the fold, as y_47301 does, and the centre block stays high as in y_47300. Its effect on q17 is only the top offset. Nothing else changed; arm, pocket, legs and pan are pixel-identical in studio. Detail mean 8.51 (w49 8.52): headrest 8.5 -> 8.4, everything else unchanged. Overall 8.6 (-0.05). The q15 fix is real and shows in the hero head-on view. The q17 wing-roll occlusion is equally visible in the side hero view and breaks the flap-in-front read, and the q17 placement is still ~45-50 px high at the foot.
